title: Kaleidoscope Mirror Symmetry Fragment Shader
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive kaleidoscope mirror symmetry effect applied as a post-processing fragment shader over a 3D scene containing a loaded GLTF model. SCENE SETUP: - Use Three.js r152+ with GLTFLoader from CDN. - Create a WebGLRenderer with antialias, sized to the full window, background color #111122. - Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at origin. - Add an AmbientLight (color 0xffffff, intensity 0.4) and a DirectionalLight (color 0xffffff, intensity 1.0) at position (5, 10, 7). - Load the model 'CesiumMilkTruck.glb' using GLTFLoader. Center it at the origin. The truck should slowly auto-rotate around the Y-axis at 0.3 radians/second. - Add a ground plane (PlaneGeometry 20x20, MeshStandardMaterial gray #555555) at y=0, rotated to be horizontal. KALEIDOSCOPE POST-PROCESSING SHADER: - Implement a two-pass rendering pipeline: first render the 3D scene to an offscreen RenderTarget (same resolution as screen), then render a fullscreen quad with a custom ShaderMaterial that applies the kaleidoscope effect. - The fragment shader must: 1. Convert UV coordinates to polar coordinates centered at (0.5, 0.5). 2. Apply angular mirror symmetry by dividing the angle into N equal segments (controlled by 'segments' uniform, default 6), then reflecting alternating segments to create kaleidoscope mirrors. 3. Convert back to cartesian UVs and sample the scene texture. 4. Apply a subtle color tint based on the original angle: mix the sampled color with a hue-shifted version (shift by angle/TWO_PI) at 15% blend. - Uniforms for the kaleidoscope shader: uSceneTexture (sampler2D), uSegments (float, default 6.0), uRotation (float, radians, default 0.0), uZoom (float, default 1.0, range 0.2-3.0), uIntensity (float, 0.0-1.0, default 1.0 meaning full kaleidoscope, 0.0 meaning raw scene). USER INTERACTIONS: - KEYBOARD: - ArrowUp / ArrowDown: increase/decrease segment count by 1 (clamp 2 to 16). Update uniform. - ArrowLeft / ArrowRight: rotate the kaleidoscope pattern by -0.1 / +0.1 radians. Update uRotation uniform. - 'Z' / 'X' keys: zoom in (decrease uZoom by 0.1, min 0.2) / zoom out (increase uZoom by 0.1, max 3.0). - 'T' key: toggle kaleidoscope on/off (set uIntensity to 0.0 or 1.0). - 'R' key: reset all shader parameters to defaults (segments=6, rotation=0, zoom=1.0, intensity=1.0). - Spacebar: pause/resume the truck auto-rotation. - DOM BUTTON: Add a button with id='btn-animate-rotation' text 'Animate Rotation' at top-right. Clicking it toggles a continuous rotation animation that increments uRotation by 0.02 each frame. HUD OVERLAY: - Create a HUD div (id='hud') at top-left with semi-transparent dark background showing: - Segments: 6 - Rotation: 0.00 (show 2 decimal places) - Zoom: 1.00 (show 2 decimal places) - Effect: ON (ON when intensity=1, OFF when intensity=0) - Truck Rotating: YES - Anim Rotation: OFF - Update HUD every frame. STATE MANAGEMENT: - Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with: - segments (number): current segment count - rotation (number): current uRotation value - zoom (number): current uZoom value - intensity (number): 0.0 or 1.0 - truckRotating (boolean): whether truck auto-rotates - truckAngle (number): current Y rotation of truck in radians - animRotation (boolean): whether continuous rotation animation is active - modelLoaded (boolean): true once GLTF is loaded - renderTargetWidth (number): width of offscreen render target - renderTargetHeight (number): height of offscreen render target - frameCount (number): incremented each animation frame - shaderCompiled (boolean): true if the kaleidoscope ShaderMaterial compiled without errors ENSURE: - The render target resizes on window resize. - All uniforms are kept in sync with __3D_STATE__. - The shader must compile without errors. - The fullscreen quad uses an OrthographicCamera (-1,1,1,-1,0,1).
physics_constraints: Truck rotation must be continuous and monotonically increasing (mod 2PI) when active. Segment count must be integer-clamped [2,16]. Zoom must be clamped [0.2, 3.0]. Rotation value must be a finite number (no NaN/Infinity). Frame count must be monotonically increasing.
